- heading "Senior Software Engineer - System Test (GPU)" [level=2]
- heading "Arm" [level=2]
- heading "Lund, Sweden" [level=2]
- heading "Job Overview:" [level=3]
- paragraph: If you are passionate about graphics and technology, we have a fantastic opportunity to apply your curiosity and creativity in shaping the future of GPU testing!
- paragraph: Join our GPU System Test team and help ensure continued success for the Mali GPUs - technology that powers millions of devices worldwide.
- paragraph: Our team focuses on system-level testing of the Vulkan, OpenGL ES and DirectX graphics APIs, developing and analyzing automated test solutions for real-world workloads to ensure our GPUs perform reliably and efficiently across platforms.
- heading "This is a unique opportunity to:" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Build your technical expertise in graphics and system testing;
  - listitem: Collaborate with experienced engineers across multiple fields;
  - listitem: Help define how Arm’s GPU technology is tested and validated for millions of users around the world.
- heading "Responsibilities:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Develop and run automated tests for Arm’s Mali GPU drivers;
  - listitem: Validate graphics performance, functionality, stability, and compatibility at the system level;
  - listitem: Contribute to new test frameworks, pipelines, and analysis tools;
  - listitem: Collaborate closely with developers, automation engineers, and performance specialists across the GPU organization.
- heading "Required Skills and Experience:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or equivalent experience in Computer science, Electrical engineering or a related field;
  - listitem: Has experience of high-level programming (Python preferred);
  - listitem: Has an analytical approach and ability to analyse logs and test results.
- heading "“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Experience from working with software testing of embedded devices;
  - listitem: Experience with shell scripting (PowerShell or Bash preferred);
  - listitem: Experience with Git.
